opaque_verification.method: Decoded original PNG is RGB, with no alpha channel or transparency entry. Full-frame material, all pixels opaque.

assets.processing: Original PNG copied unchanged; no resizing, color adjustment, seam repair, alpha processing or re-encoding. Derivative QA previews are separate.

placement.note: Not an object sprite. Source has no patch perimeter; production owns world UVs and irregular ground blending, not a collider/physical footprint from this square.

source_statistics.note: 8-bit ungraded source statistics, not scene brightness or aesthetic acceptance.

repeat_guide.basis: Read-only WorldArt.gd: _GROUND_GRASS_REPEAT_WORLD_PX=320 and grass-like indices include existing grass/moss. No integration/index mapping performed.
repeat_guide.note: 320px and160px preview tile widths bracket two scale assumptions. They do not confirm the actual current camera zoom, texture-array preprocessing, grading, blending or lighting.

seam_measurements.meaning: RGB absolute-difference wrap statistics versus adjacent pixel means; diagnostic only, not pass/fail or seamlessness proof.

qa_previews.method: Unscaled native source four-corner periodic wrap cross, joins at image center. Preview only.
3x3 direct periodic repeat; source reduced with Pillow LANCZOS for QA only. No color adjustment, edge blending, offset repair or scene shader.
3x3 direct periodic repeat; source reduced with Pillow LANCZOS for QA only. No color adjustment, edge blending, offset repair or scene shader.

visual_review.subject: Short fine irregular grass, muted olive with straw wear and thinning; no rosettes, props, border or patch silhouette.
visual_review.native_wrap: No dominant straight seam at inspected source-pixel wrap cross; individual blade flow still changes at wrap. Not pixel-exact seam certification.
visual_review.scaled_repeat: No strong rectangular tile boundary at320px or160px repeat samples. Recurrent wispy diagonal flow and low-frequency wear cadence can be identified in a3x3 field.
visual_review.limits: Fine pale/wiry blades remain more detailed than broad paint at source resolution; judge muted olive warmth, cared-lawn identity and actor contrast in actual S2. No source repainting or seam repair.
visual_review.lead_retained_limits: Slight dry olive lawn character and broad repeated mottling; judge actual S2 with actors.

visual_review.subject: Low fine olive/brown-green moss, neutral damp soil and small subdued grit; no cyan/blue/purple broad leaves, flowers, water scene or patch outline.
visual_review.native_wrap: Small edge-structure discontinuities remain visible in the native wrap cross, especially along the horizontal join; no repaired seam was substituted.
visual_review.scaled_repeat: No strong rectangular tile boundary at320px/160px samples, but repeated mottled soil/grit clusters remain identifiable in a3x3 field. Slightly stronger texture/value variation than lawn.
visual_review.limits: Mean source luma is about8 levels lower than lawn. Moss is earthy/warm and has fine gritty speckles; native S7 appearance and actor subordination remain pending. Not certified seamless.
visual_review.lead_retained_limits: Broad repeated mottling and moss grit at320px repeat; judge actual S7 with actors.
